T012 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  (∀ (s δ ε : ℝ),
      0 < s →
        0 < δ →
          0 < ε →
            ∀ (Vc : ℕ → Set (W n)), IsCover δ (cyl n E) Vc → Hscale s δ E ≤ coverCost (s + 1) Vc + ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
    ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → Hscale s δ E ≤ Hscale (s + 1) δ (cyl n E)
'Translation.T012' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
